description: Defines data structures and classes for managing UE (User Equipment) context in a 5G/4G scheduler, including UE cell lookup, UE handle class with methods for handling various UE-related indications and configurations.

classes.name: ue
classes.description: Represents a User Equipment (UE) in the scheduler, managing UE-specific state, configurations, and handling various indications and operations.

methods.name: slot_indication
methods.description: Handles slot indication for the UE.

methods.name: find_cell
methods.description: Finds a UE cell by DU cell index.

methods.name: get_cell
methods.description: Fetches a UE cell by serv_cell_index_t.

methods.name: get_pcell
methods.description: Fetches the primary cell (PCell) of the UE.

methods.name: nof_cells
methods.description: Returns the number of cells configured for the UE.

methods.name: is_ca_enabled
methods.description: Checks if Carrier Aggregation is enabled.

methods.name: handle_ul_n_ta_update_indication
methods.description: Handles uplink N_TA (Timing Advance) update indication.

methods.name: handle_dl_mac_ce_indication
methods.description: Handles downlink MAC Control Element indication.

methods.name: handle_reconfiguration_request
methods.description: Handles new UE configuration during RRC reconfiguration.

methods.name: pending_ul_newtx_bytes
methods.description: Calculates pending uplink bytes not allocated in UL HARQ.
